nursery rhyme: The children sang an old nursery rhyme while playing in the garden.
孩子们在花园里玩耍时唱着一首古老的童谣。
hush: A sudden hush fell over the classroom when the teacher walked in.
老师走进教室时,教室里顿时一片安静。
mockingbird: The mockingbird can copy the songs of many other birds.
嘲鸫能模仿许多其他鸟类的歌声。
billy-goat: The old billy-goat pushed the smaller goats away from the food.
那只老公山羊把小山羊们从食物旁挤开。
squire: In the story, the kind squire owned most of the land in the village.
在故事里,那位善良的乡绅拥有村里大部分的土地。
coffin: The family walked slowly behind the coffin during the funeral.
葬礼上,家人缓缓走在棺木后面。
take it easy: The doctor told him to take it easy for a few weeks after the operation.
医生告诉他手术后几周内要放松休息,别太劳累。
run out of: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop to buy some.
我们的牛奶用完了,所以我去商店买了一些。
cinquain: For homework, we each wrote a cinquain about the autumn leaves.
作业要求我们每人写一首关于秋叶的五行诗。
be made up of: Our class is made up of students from three different cities.
我们班由来自三个不同城市的学生组成。
droop: The flowers drooped in the heat because nobody had watered them.
因为没有人浇水,花儿在高温下都低垂凋萎了。
haiku: A haiku is a short Japanese poem with only seventeen syllables.
俳句是一种短小的日本诗歌,只有十七个音节。
brimful: The basket was brimful of fresh apples picked from the orchard.
篮子里装满了从果园摘来的新鲜苹果。
in particular: I love all kinds of fruit, mangoes in particular.
各种水果我都喜欢,尤其是芒果。
bridegroom: The bridegroom looked nervous as he waited for the wedding to begin.
新郎在等待婚礼开始时显得很紧张。
let out: She let out a loud scream when she saw the snake.
看到蛇时,她发出一声尖叫。
alcoholic: The doctor warned him that alcoholic drinks were damaging his health.
医生警告他,含酒精的饮料正在损害他的健康。
due to: The football match was cancelled due to the heavy rain.
由于大雨,足球比赛被取消了。
addicted: He became addicted to computer games and failed several exams.
他迷上了电脑游戏,好几门考试都没及格。
addicted to: She is addicted to chocolate and eats some every single day.
她对巧克力上了瘾,每天都要吃一些。
accustomed to: After a month in the city, he was accustomed to the noisy streets.
在这座城市住了一个月后,他已经习惯了喧闹的街道。
bad-tempered: Our bad-tempered neighbour shouted at the children for making noise.
我们那位脾气暴躁的邻居因孩子们吵闹而大声呵斥他们。
mentally: Solving these puzzles keeps you mentally active as you grow older.
解这些谜题能让你在年纪渐长时保持思维活跃。
unfit: He was unfit for the job because he had no relevant experience.
他不能胜任这份工作,因为他没有相关经验。
decide on: After comparing three plans, we finally decided on the cheapest one.
比较了三个方案后,我们最终选定了最便宜的那个。
feel like: It is so hot today; I feel like a cold drink.
今天太热了,我想要一杯冷饮。
feel like doing: I feel like watching a movie tonight instead of studying.
今晚我不想学习,想去看场电影。
chewing gum: Please throw away your chewing gum before entering the library.
进图书馆前请把口香糖扔掉。
in spite of: In spite of the bad weather, we enjoyed our trip to the mountains.
尽管天气不好,我们的山地之行还是很愉快。
take a risk: Sometimes you have to take a risk if you want something better.
有时候,如果你想得到更好的东西,就得冒一次险。
etc: Remember to bring pens, notebooks, scissors, etc. to the art class.
记得把钢笔、笔记本、剪刀等用品带到美术课上。
HIV: Doctors taught the students how HIV spreads and how to stay safe.
医生向学生们讲解了艾滋病病毒是如何传播的,以及如何保护自己。
AIDS: Scientists around the world are still working to find a cure for AIDS.
世界各地的科学家仍在努力寻找治疗艾滋病的方法。
at risk: Many old buildings are at risk of falling down if no one repairs them.
如果没人修缮,许多古老建筑都有倒塌的危险。
SARS: SARS spread quickly in 2003, so people washed their hands more often.
2003年非典型性肺炎传播得很快,所以人们更加勤于洗手。
condom: Health classes teach young people that condoms can help prevent some diseases.
健康课教导年轻人,避孕套有助于预防某些疾病。
homosexual: Everyone should be respected, whether they are homosexual or not.
无论是否同性恋,每个人都应该受到尊重。
disco: There was a disco at the school hall last Friday night.
上周五晚上,学校礼堂里举办了一场迪斯科舞会。
come about: Nobody knows exactly how the fire came about late last night.
没有人确切知道昨晚的大火是怎么发生的。
Sophie: Sophie invited her friends to her house for a birthday party.
索菲邀请朋友们到她家参加生日聚会。
